head: 3093e2d3
label: CP7_OW05B_MANDOR_GUIDANCE_NATIVE6

cases.OW05B_CORRECTION_COMMAND_UNCHANGED: INCOMPLETE: AssertionError at cases.py:205 assert w['review_token']!=old['review_token']

cause: Two wrong expectations in this stage's own new cases, not product: (1) the finished real chain has no work-journal blocker; it has GROUP_STATE and WIP_HISTORY, and its blockers equal the predecessor's exactly (the next assertion); WORK_JOURNAL guidance is already proven by OW05B_EVERY_KIND_AND_BRANCH_GUIDED. (2) The guidance stage does not touch the review token (no line of the stage computes it); the token is over the facts the operator decides on, so it is the same as before the stage, and the correction command is unchanged as the case name says.
fix: real_chain expects the chain's actual blocker kinds; command_unchanged asserts the token is unchanged. No predecessor oracle, product line or guard changed.
